title: Lean 4 Formalization, Kahn Topological Sort & Trace Compiler (v0.1.0–v0.1.1)
public_safety_audit_summary: Establishes the foundational Lean 4 ordering proofs, Kahn topological sort with cycle detection (KahnSortResult::CycleDetected), and initial #![no_std] state resolution kernel. Identifies two enduring public-safety considerations documented in TODO.txt and rezzy_docs_public_safety_audit.md: (1) cycle detection in build_mainline_with_cache silently truncates mainlines rather than returning an explicit Result error, and (2) the behavioral gap in single-pass progressiveFold termination under mutual demotion in V2.1.1 empty-start-state semantics.
